title: How Many Grams Are in an Eighth?
seoTitle: How Many Grams Are in an Eighth? | Uforia Dispensary
description: An eighth of cannabis is 3.5 grams, or one eighth of an ounce. See how the common flower weights compare, from a single gram up to a full 28-gram ounce.
lede: An eighth of cannabis is 3.5 grams. The name is short for an eighth of an ounce, and it is one of the most common sizes you will see on a flower menu.

sections.heading: Where the 3.5 comes from
sections.html:
Cannabis flower has long been sold in fractions of an ounce, even though most labels today list weight in grams. A standard ounce weighs about 28.35 grams, and in everyday cannabis shopping that figure is rounded down to an even 28. Divide 28 by eight and you get 3.5 grams: an eighth.

The mix of ounces and grams can feel confusing at first, since people tend to talk in fractions while packages show grams. The pattern is simple once you see it, though. Each step up the ladder doubles the one before it, so two eighths make a quarter, and two quarters make a half.

sections.heading: Common weights at a glance
sections.html:
These are the sizes you are most likely to come across, along with the nicknames people use for them:

  • Gram: 1 gram. A handy size for sampling a strain you have not tried.
  • Eighth: 3.5 grams, or one eighth of an ounce.
  • Quarter: 7 grams, or one quarter of an ounce, equal to two eighths.
  • Half: 14 grams, or half an ounce, sometimes called a half O.
  • Ounce: 28 grams, often shortened to an O or a zip.

You may also see a half gram, a common size for pre-rolls and vape cartridges.

sections.heading: Why two eighths can look different
sections.html:
Weight and size do not always line up. A dense, tightly packed bud can weigh more than a larger, airier one, so an eighth of one strain might look noticeably smaller than an eighth of another. Both still weigh the same.

Moisture plays a part, too. Flower loses a little water over time, so a container that has been open for a while may weigh slightly less than it did when it was packed. If you like to check, a small digital scale that measures to a tenth of a gram makes it easy.

sections.heading: Choosing a size that suits you
sections.html:
How long an eighth lasts depends entirely on the person. Someone who enjoys an occasional joint may make it stretch for weeks, while a daily consumer might finish it sooner. For a rough sense of scale, a typical pre-roll holds somewhere between half a gram and a full gram of flower.

If you are trying a strain for the first time, a smaller size lets you get to know it before committing to more. An eighth is a popular middle ground, enough to enjoy a strain across several sessions. Whatever you choose, an airtight container kept away from heat and light keeps flower fresh for longer.

For how much you can buy at one time, see our guide to understanding cannabis purchase limits. When you are ready, you can compare sizes on Uforia's live flower menu.

takeaways: An eighth is 3.5 grams, or one eighth of an ounce.
Cannabis rounds an ounce to 28 grams, so a quarter is 7 grams and a half is 14.
Dense buds weigh more for their size, so equal weights can look different.
A smaller size is a good way to get to know a new strain.
